title: BG broadcast issue with NFC and libre
symptom: When scanning a Libre over NFC with a few hours between scans, xdrip-plus broadcasts several times the same last value instead of broadcasting all new values since last scan.
cause: The feature called 'Display Glucose' which includes noise compensation and calibration plugins needs to be updated to support data coming in out of sequence.
fix: Uncheck 'Send Display Glucose' in Settings -> Inter-app Settings to avoid the issue.
evidence_quote: I unchecked this and no more issue!
